steps.text: The rack has an open top and enough footprint for both mugs side by side, which gives a clear access path. I’ll grasp each mug from above, carry it above the rack, and set it on the top panel; that avoids threading the gripper between the shelves.

const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""Generate the frozen-instance put_mugs_on_shelf trajectory."""
+from pathlib import Path
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_robolab import Session
+
+
+OUT = Path("/app/output")
+s = Session("put_mugs_on_shelf", instance="/app/instance.json")
+p = s.primitives()
+
+# The rack's top panel is at the top of its AABB.  With a vertical side grasp,
+# the tool point is at the mug's mid-height; carrying at z=.62 clears the panel.
+RACK_TOP = float(s.objects()["rack_l04"]["bounds"][1][2])
+CARRY_Z = RACK_TOP + 0.115
+PLACE_Z = RACK_TOP + 0.045
+RACK_X = float(s.objects()["rack_l04"]["position"][0])
+
+
+def pick_and_place(name, close_dir, dest_y):
+    info = s.objects()[name]
+    x, y = info["position"][:2]
+    lo, hi = info["bounds"]
+    grasp_z = (lo[2] + hi[2]) / 2
+    yaw = p["yaw_for_closing_dir"](close_dir)
+    quat = p["top_down_quat"](yaw)
+
+    p["open_gripper"](steps=4)
+    p["move_ee"]([x, y, 0.18], quat, speed=0.18, max_steps=300)
+    p["move_ee"]([x, y, grasp_z], quat, speed=0.10, max_steps=300)
+    p["close_gripper"](steps=18)
+    p["move_ee"]([x, y, 0.18], quat, speed=0.12, max_steps=300)
+
+    # Stay in front of the rack while rising, then cross above its top panel.
+    p["move_ee"]([0.40, dest_y, CARRY_Z], quat, speed=0.18, max_steps=360)
+    p["move_ee"]([RACK_X, dest_y, CARRY_Z], quat, speed=0.14, max_steps=300)
+    p["move_ee"]([RACK_X, dest_y, PLACE_Z], quat, speed=0.10, max_steps=300)
+    p["open_gripper"](steps=20)
+    p["hold"](10)
+    # Lift clear of the mug so the termination can observe gripper detachment.
+    p["move_ee"]([RACK_X, dest_y, CARRY_Z], quat, speed=0.12, max_steps=300)
+
+
+s.reset()
+s.record_start()
+
+# The mug at negative y has its handle along x; the white ceramic mug has its
+# handle along y.  Close through each mug's body, away from its handle.
+pick_and_place("mug", [0.0, 1.0], -0.060)
+if not s.episode_done:
+    pick_and_place("ceramic_mug", [1.0, 0.0], 0.105)
+
+actions = s.record_stop()
+status = s.status()
+print("trajectory actions:", actions.shape, "status:", status, flush=True)
+print("final objects:", s.objects(), flush=True)
+if not status["success"]:
+    raise RuntimeError("Trajectory did not satisfy the task success predicate")
+
+s.save_trajectory(actions, OUT / "trajectory.npz", meta={
+    "method": "top-down side grasps, top-panel placement",
+    "mug_targets_y": [-0.060, 0.105],
+    "rack_top_z": RACK_TOP,
+    "success": status["success"],
+})
+print("saved", OUT / "trajectory.npz", flush=True)
*** End Patch";

"""Generate the frozen-instance put_mugs_on_shelf trajectory."""
from pathlib import Path
import atexit
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation, Slerp
import rcb_robolab as rcb


# Keep the same scene and CPU physics while replacing the registration's full
# resolution observation cameras with a tiny viewport sensor. The trajectory
# itself uses only kinematics and physics; this keeps generation viable on a
# shared GPU without changing any object, robot, or control settings.
_original_launch_app = rcb._launch_app


def _launch_with_small_camera():
    app = _original_launch_app()
    from isaaclab.utils import configclass
    from isaaclab.sensors import TiledCameraCfg
    import isaaclab.sim as sim_utils
    from robolab.registrations.droid import auto_env_registrations_jointpos as registrations
    from robolab.robots.droid import DroidCfg

    # The wrist camera is also a 720p sensor on DroidCfg itself. It is not used
    # by this replay trajectory, so omit it along with the scene image cameras.
    DroidCfg.wrist_cam = None

    @configclass
    class SmallViewportCfg:
        small_viewport = TiledCameraCfg(
            prim_path="{ENV_REGEX_NS}/small_viewport",
            height=32,
            width=32,
            data_types=["rgb"],
            spawn=sim_utils.PinholeCameraCfg(focal_length=2.8),
        )

    original_register = registrations.auto_register_droid_envs

    def register_small_camera(**kwargs):
        kwargs["cameras"] = []
        kwargs["viewport_camera"] = SmallViewportCfg
        return original_register(**kwargs)

    registrations.auto_register_droid_envs = register_small_camera
    return app


rcb._launch_app = _launch_with_small_camera
Session = rcb.Session


OUT = Path("/app/output")
s = Session("put_mugs_on_shelf", instance="/app/instance.json")
atexit.register(s.close)
p = s.primitives()


def make_fk():
    """Panda hand FK, calibrated to RoboLab's live gripper flange frame."""
    urdf = "/opt/robolab/.venv/lib/python3.11/site-packages/isaaclab/source/isaaclab/isaaclab/controllers/config/data/lula_franka_gen.urdf"
    root = ET.parse(urdf).getroot()
    parent_joint = {}
    for joint in root.findall("joint"):
        name = joint.get("name", "")
        if name == "panda_hand_joint" or (name.startswith("panda_joint") and int(name[11:]) <= 8):
            parent_joint[joint.find("child").get("link")] = joint
    chain = []
    link = "panda_hand"
    while link != "panda_link0":
        joint = parent_joint[link]
        chain.append(joint)
        link = joint.find("parent").get("link")
    chain.reverse()

    def vec(text, default):
        return np.array([float(x) for x in text.split()]) if text else np.asarray(default, float)

    def fk(q):
        transform = np.eye(4)
        index = 0
        for joint in chain:
            origin = joint.find("origin")
            op = np.eye(4)
            op[:3, 3] = vec(origin.get("xyz"), [0, 0, 0])
            op[:3, :3] = Rotation.from_euler("xyz", vec(origin.get("rpy"), [0, 0, 0])).as_matrix()
            transform = transform @ op
            if joint.get("type") == "revolute":
                axis = vec(joint.find("axis").get("xyz"), [0, 0, 1])
                rot = np.eye(4)
                rot[:3, :3] = Rotation.from_rotvec(axis * q[index]).as_matrix()
                transform = transform @ rot
                index += 1
        return transform

    q0 = s.joint_positions()
    fp, fq = s.eef_frame_pose()
    actual = np.eye(4)
    actual[:3, :3] = Rotation.from_quat(np.asarray(fq)[[1, 2, 3, 0]]).as_matrix()
    actual[:3, 3] = fp
    fixed = np.linalg.inv(fk(q0)) @ actual
    limits = np.array([
        [-2.8973, 2.8973], [-1.7628, 1.7628], [-2.8973, 2.8973],
        [-3.0718, -0.0698], [-2.8973, 2.8973], [-0.0175, 3.7525],
        [-2.8973, 2.8973],
    ])

    def solve(tcp_pos, tcp_quat, seed):
        seed = np.clip(seed, limits[:, 0] + 1e-8, limits[:, 1] - 1e-8)
        rot = Rotation.from_quat(np.asarray(tcp_quat)[[1, 2, 3, 0]])
        flange_pos = np.asarray(tcp_pos, float) - 0.162 * rot.as_matrix()[:, 2]

        def residual(q):
            cur = fk(q) @ fixed
            pos_err = cur[:3, 3] - flange_pos
            rot_err = Rotation.from_matrix(rot.as_matrix().T @ cur[:3, :3]).as_rotvec()
            return np.r_[pos_err, 0.25 * rot_err, 0.0001 * (q - seed)]

        result = least_squares(
            residual, seed, bounds=(limits[:, 0], limits[:, 1]),
            max_nfev=180, xtol=1e-10, ftol=1e-10, gtol=1e-10,
        )
        err = residual(result.x)
        if np.linalg.norm(err[:3]) > 0.002 or np.linalg.norm(err[3:6]) > 0.02:
            raise RuntimeError(f"offline IK failed: pos={np.linalg.norm(err[:3]):.4f}m rot={np.linalg.norm(err[3:6])/.25:.3f}rad")
        return result.x

    return solve, q0


ik, _qseed = make_fk()


def quat_slerp(q0, q1, fraction):
    rotations = Rotation.from_quat(np.asarray([q0, q1])[:, [1, 2, 3, 0]])
    q = Slerp([0.0, 1.0], rotations)([fraction]).as_quat()[0]
    return q[[3, 0, 1, 2]]


def move_tcp(pos, quat):
    """Drive short Cartesian increments with bounded joint targets."""
    global _qseed
    start_pos, start_quat = s.ee_pose()
    dist = float(np.linalg.norm(np.asarray(pos) - start_pos))
    angle = float((Rotation.from_quat(np.asarray(start_quat)[[1, 2, 3, 0]]).inv() *
                   Rotation.from_quat(np.asarray(quat)[[1, 2, 3, 0]])).magnitude())
    n = max(1, int(np.ceil(max(dist / 0.005, angle / 0.04))))
    q = _qseed
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        f = i / n
        wp = np.asarray(start_pos) + (np.asarray(pos) - start_pos) * f
        wq = quat_slerp(start_quat, quat, f)
        goal = ik(wp, wq, q)
        steps = max(1, int(np.ceil(np.max(np.abs(goal - q)) / 0.04)))
        p["move_joints"](goal, steps=steps)
        q = goal
    p["hold"](3)
    _qseed = s.joint_positions()
    actual_pos, actual_quat = s.ee_pose()
    pos_error = float(np.linalg.norm(np.asarray(actual_pos) - np.asarray(pos)))
    rot_error = float((Rotation.from_quat(np.asarray(actual_quat)[[1, 2, 3, 0]]).inv() *
                        Rotation.from_quat(np.asarray(quat)[[1, 2, 3, 0]])).magnitude())
    print(f"move_tcp target={np.round(pos, 3)} actual={np.round(actual_pos, 3)} err={pos_error:.3f}m/{rot_error:.3f}rad", flush=True)

# The rack's top panel is at the top of its AABB.  With a vertical side grasp,
# the tool point is at the mug's mid-height; carrying at z=.62 clears the panel.
RACK_TOP = float(s.objects()["rack_l04"]["bounds"][1][2])
CARRY_Z = RACK_TOP + 0.115
PLACE_Z = RACK_TOP + 0.045
RACK_X = float(s.objects()["rack_l04"]["position"][0])


def pick_and_place(name, close_dir, dest_y):
    info = s.objects()[name]
    x, y = info["position"][:2]
    lo, hi = info["bounds"]
    x += 0.015
    grasp_z = hi[2] - 0.025
    yaw = p["yaw_for_closing_dir"](close_dir)
    quat = p["top_down_quat"](yaw)

    p["open_gripper"](steps=4)
    move_tcp([x, y, 0.18], quat)
    move_tcp([x, y, grasp_z], quat)
    p["close_gripper"](steps=18)
    print("after close", name, s.objects()[name]["position"], "ee", s.ee_pose()[0], flush=True)
    move_tcp([x, y, 0.18], quat)
    print("after lift", name, s.objects()[name]["position"], flush=True)

    # Stay in front of the rack while rising, then cross above its top panel.
    move_tcp([0.40, dest_y, CARRY_Z], quat)
    move_tcp([RACK_X, dest_y, CARRY_Z], quat)
    move_tcp([RACK_X, dest_y, PLACE_Z], quat)
    print("before release", name, s.objects()[name]["position"], "ee", s.ee_pose()[0], flush=True)
    p["open_gripper"](steps=20)
    p["hold"](10)
    print("after release", name, s.objects()[name]["position"], flush=True)
    # Lift clear of the mug so the termination can observe gripper detachment.
    move_tcp([RACK_X, dest_y, CARRY_Z], quat)


s.reset()
s.record_start()

# The mug at negative y has its handle along x; the white ceramic mug has its
# handle along y.  Close through each mug's body, away from its handle.
pick_and_place("mug", [0.0, 1.0], -0.060)
if not s.episode_done:
    # Retract to the rack's front, then cross back above the table before
    # descending to the second mug. Keep the orientation change up high.
    quat2 = p["top_down_quat"](p["yaw_for_closing_dir"]([1.0, 0.0]))
    move_tcp([0.40, -0.060, CARRY_Z], p["top_down_quat"](p["yaw_for_closing_dir"]([0.0, 1.0])))
    ceramic = s.objects()["ceramic_mug"]
    move_tcp([ceramic["position"][0] + 0.015, ceramic["position"][1], CARRY_Z], quat2)
    pick_and_place("ceramic_mug", [1.0, 0.0], 0.105)

actions = s.record_stop()
status = s.status()
print("trajectory actions:", actions.shape, "status:", status, flush=True)
print("final objects:", s.objects(), flush=True)
if not status["success"]:
    raise RuntimeError("Trajectory did not satisfy the task success predicate")

s.save_trajectory(actions, OUT / "trajectory.npz", meta={
    "method": "top-down side grasps, top-panel placement",
    "mug_targets_y": [-0.060, 0.105],
    "rack_top_z": RACK_TOP,
    "success": status["success"],
})
print("saved", OUT / "trajectory.npz", flush=True)
